# typescript-eslint

> > Tooling that enables ESLint and Prettier to support TypeScript, providing type-aware linting rules and modern flat config support.

typescript-eslint is the standard solution for linting TypeScript code with ESLint. It includes @typescript-eslint/parser and @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin, with advanced features like Project Service for simplified type-checked linting in monorepos and large codebases.

## Configuration & Troubleshooting

- [Monorepo Configuration](https://typescript-eslint.io/troubleshooting/typed-linting/monorepos): Configure typed linting for monorepos using Project Service or tsconfig
- [Performance](https://typescript-eslint.io/troubleshooting/typed-linting/performance): Troubleshoot typed linting performance: slow rules, debugging, optimization
- [What About TSLint?](https://typescript-eslint.io/users/what-about-tslint): TSLint deprecation notice & migration guide to typescript-eslint
- [What About Formatting?](https://typescript-eslint.io/users/what-about-formatting): Use Prettier/dprint for formatting; ESLint for linting logic & naming
- [ESLint FAQs](https://typescript-eslint.io/troubleshooting/faqs/eslint): ESLint-specific FAQs: extension rules, no-undef with TypeScript, JSX support
- [TypeScript FAQs](https://typescript-eslint.io/troubleshooting/faqs/typescript): TypeScript FAQs: installation, parser options, versions, ts-expect-error
- [General FAQs](https://typescript-eslint.io/troubleshooting/faqs/general): General FAQs: rule configuration, ESTree, no-restricted-syntax usage
- [JavaScript FAQs](https://typescript-eslint.io/troubleshooting/faqs/javascript): JavaScript-specific FAQs: pure JS files, file extensions, transpiled output
- [Framework FAQs](https://typescript-eslint.io/troubleshooting/faqs/frameworks): Framework integration FAQs: Vue custom extensions, parser configuration

## Rules Reference

- [naming-convention](https://typescript-eslint.io/rules/naming-convention): Rule: enforce naming conventions with granular selectors (frozen, typed)
- [prefer-promise-reject-errors](https://typescript-eslint.io/rules/prefer-promise-reject-errors): Rule: require Error objects as Promise rejection reasons (type-checked)
- [explicit-function-return-type](https://typescript-eslint.io/rules/explicit-function-return-type): Rule: require explicit return types on functions and class methods
- [no-wrapper-object-types](https://typescript-eslint.io/rules/no-wrapper-object-types): Rule: disallow wrapper object types (String vs string) - auto-fixable
- [no-namespace](https://typescript-eslint.io/rules/no-namespace): Rule: disallow TypeScript namespaces in favor of ES2015 modules
- [explicit-member-accessibility](https://typescript-eslint.io/rules/explicit-member-accessibility): Rule: require explicit public/private/protected on class members (fixable)
